WITH dso_by_sub AS (
  SELECT pa.subsidiary_key, 
         SUM(pa.days_to_pay * pa.amount_applied) / SUM(pa.amount_applied) AS dso_value
  FROM mro_distributor.ar_payment_application pa
  GROUP BY pa.subsidiary_key
),
dio_by_sub AS (
  SELECT snap.subsidiary_key,
         (SELECT AVG(daily_value) FROM (
            SELECT snap2.snapshot_date_key, SUM(snap2.value_on_hand) AS daily_value
            FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot snap2
            WHERE snap2.subsidiary_key = snap.subsidiary_key
            GROUP BY snap2.snapshot_date_key))
         /
         (SELECT SUM(sol.ext_cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT sol.order_date_key)
          FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol
          WHERE sol.subsidiary_key = snap.subsidiary_key) AS dio_value
  FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot snap
  GROUP BY snap.subsidiary_key
),
dpo_by_sub AS (
  SELECT bp.subsidiary_key,
         SUM(bp.days_to_pay * bp.amount_paid) / SUM(bp.amount_paid) AS dpo_value
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_bill_payment bp
  GROUP BY bp.subsidiary_key
),
ccc_by_sub AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(d.subsidiary_key, i.subsidiary_key, p.subsidiary_key) AS subsidiary_key,
         COALESCE(d.dso_value, 0) AS dso,
         COALESCE(i.dio_value, 0) AS dio,
         COALESCE(p.dpo_value, 0) AS dpo,
         COALESCE(d.dso_value, 0) + COALESCE(i.dio_value, 0) - COALESCE(p.dpo_value, 0) AS ccc
  FROM dso_by_sub d
  FULL OUTER JOIN dio_by_sub i USING (subsidiary_key)
  FULL OUTER JOIN dpo_by_sub p USING (subsidiary_key)
)
SELECT ds.subsidiary_name,
       c.ccc AS cash_conversion_cycle_days,
       c.dso AS dso_days,
       c.dio AS dio_days,
       c.dpo AS dpo_days,
       CASE 
         WHEN c.dio >= c.dso AND c.dio >= c.dpo THEN 'DIO'
         WHEN c.dso >= c.dio AND c.dso >= c.dpo THEN 'DSO'
         ELSE 'DPO'
       END AS highest_component
FROM ccc_by_sub c
LEFT JOIN mro_distributor.dim_subsidiary ds USING (subsidiary_key)
ORDER BY c.ccc DESC
LIMIT 1000

question: Compare fast-moving versus slow-moving items: which group suffers more from supplier lateness?

sql_generation.sql:
WITH velocity AS (
  SELECT ff.item_key, SUM(ff.qty_shipped) AS units_shipped
  FROM mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff
  GROUP BY ff.item_key
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT quantile_cont(units_shipped, 0.2) AS q20
  FROM velocity
),
item_supplier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT po.item_key, po.supplier_key
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po
),
item_classification AS (
  SELECT v.item_key,
         CASE WHEN v.units_shipped <= c.q20 THEN 'Slow-Moving' ELSE 'Fast-Moving' END AS movement_class
  FROM velocity v, cutoff c
),
supplier_lateness AS (
  SELECT ic.movement_class,
         AVG(po.late_days) AS avg_supplier_late_days,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.supplier_key) AS supplier_count,
         COUNT(po.po_line_key) AS po_line_count
  FROM item_classification ic
  JOIN item_supplier m ON ic.item_key = m.item_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po ON m.item_key = po.item_key AND m.supplier_key = po.supplier_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_supplier s ON po.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
  GROUP BY ic.movement_class
)
SELECT movement_class,
       avg_supplier_late_days,
       supplier_count,
       po_line_count
FROM supplier_lateness
ORDER BY avg_supplier_late_days DESC
LIMIT 1000

WITH otif_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    sol.so_line_key,
    sol.qty_ordered,
    ff.qty_shipped,
    sol.promised_ship_date_key,
    ff.ship_date_key,
    ff.item_key,
    CASE 
      WHEN ff.ship_date_key IS NULL THEN 'Never Shipped'
      WHEN ff.ship_date_key > sol.promised_ship_date_key AND ff.qty_shipped < sol.qty_ordered THEN 'Both Late and Short'
      WHEN ff.ship_date_key > sol.promised_ship_date_key THEN 'Late Only'
      WHEN ff.qty_shipped < sol.qty_ordered THEN 'Short Only'
      ELSE 'On Time In Full'

  LEFT JOIN mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff USING (so_line_key)
),
miss_summary AS (
  SELECT
    miss_type,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS pct_of_total
  FROM otif_analysis
  WHERE miss_type != 'On Time In Full'
  GROUP BY miss_type
),
late_suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    oa.miss_type,
    s.supplier_name,
    s.reliability_tier,
    COUNT(oa.so_line_key) AS line_count,
    COUNT(oa.so_line_key) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(oa.so_line_key)) OVER (PARTITION BY oa.miss_type) AS pct_of_miss_type
  FROM otif_analysis oa
  JOIN mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff ON oa.so_line_key = ff.so_line_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po ON ff.item_key = po.item_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_supplier s USING (supplier_key)
  WHERE oa.miss_type IN ('Late Only', 'Both Late and Short')
  GROUP BY oa.miss_type, s.supplier_name, s.reliability_tier
  ORDER BY oa.miss_type, pct_of_miss_type DESC
)
SELECT
  'Miss Type Summary' AS category,
  miss_type AS detail,
  line_count,
  ROUND(pct_of_total, 2) AS pct_of_total,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS supplier_name,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS reliability_tier,
  NULL::BIGINT AS supplier_line_count,
  NULL::NUMERIC AS supplier_pct
FROM miss_summary
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Suppliers Behind Late Misses',
  miss_type,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  supplier_name,
  reliability_tier,
  line_count,
  ROUND(pct_of_miss_type, 2)
FROM late_suppliers
ORDER BY category, detail, supplier_pct DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000
